channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Mexico's Hacienda projects 1.5–2.5% GDP growth for 2027
item.description: Finance Secretary Édgar Amador Zamora delivered the 2027 economic package to Congress, projecting 2% GDP growth and tighter deficit targets.

item.title: Márquez kicks off Liga MX club tour as Mexico's new head coach
item.description: The new El Tri boss began a whirlwind 18-club swing on September 9, starting where his career started: Atlas in Guadalajara.

item.title: Mamdani's 9/11 attendance and Netanyahu arrest call dominate NYC politics
item.description: Two overlapping controversies around New York's new mayor reveal long-running tensions about identity, accountability, and who gets to define public memory.

item.title: Trezeguet praises Rafa Márquez as Chino Huerta eyes national team return
item.description: David Trezeguet backs Rafa Márquez's coaching credentials while César Huerta targets a full comeback with El Tri under Mexico's new boss.

item.title: Trump's pre-midterm moves stoke GOP anxiety ahead of Dallas convention
item.description: With more than 100 GOP lawmakers expected to skip the Dallas convention, party chairman Joe Gruters warned of 'almost certain defeat' weeks before November.

item.title: Trump-backed DiLorenzo wins GOP primary for New Hampshire's 1st District
item.description: Anthony DiLorenzo, backed by President Trump, captured 51.5 percent of the vote to advance to a competitive November general election.

item.title: Republicans hold first-ever midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: The Republican National Committee convenes its first midterm convention in Dallas on Sept. 9–10, with President Trump scheduled to speak both nights.

item.title: New Hampshire holds primary for Senate, governor, and Congress
item.description: New Hampshire voters selected nominees Tuesday for U.S. Senate, governor, and Congress, setting up November contests in several competitive races.

item.title: Messi reaches preliminary deal to acquire Spanish second-division club Eldense
item.description: The Argentine star, 39, would buy 100% of the struggling Alicante club solo, pending due diligence and Spanish government approval.

item.title: Missouri congressional map dispute splits Supreme Court and federal court
item.description: A Supreme Court justice and a federal district judge issued contradictory rulings within minutes, leaving Missouri's congressional map—and the November election—in legal limbo.

item.title: Mexico falls to Poland 2-1, nears elimination at U-20 Women's World Cup
item.description: A 76th-minute VAR penalty handed Poland a 2-1 win, leaving Mexico one point from two games and staring at elimination.

item.title: Colombia and US sign Barranquilla Accords on reconstruction, economy and security
item.description: Rubio and de la Espriella unveiled the Barranquilla Accords on September 8, targeting reconstruction, economic recovery, and hemispheric security after a deadly earthquake.

item.title: US strikes Iranian tankers, sanctions airlines amid widening conflict
item.description: U.S. forces struck Iranian tankers Tuesday and Treasury sanctioned 27 airlines as fighting over missiles, oil shipping, and aviation escalated sharply.

item.title: Paxton whistleblower Maxwell endorses Talarico for Texas Senate
item.description: David Maxwell, who reported Ken Paxton to the FBI in 2020, backed Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico on September 8, 2026.

item.title: Messi reaches preliminary deal to acquire Spanish second-division club Eldense
item.description: The Argentine star's legal team has been negotiating for months with Colombian firm TH Group, with Spanish government approval still required.

item.title: Feid brings short film 'El Green Print' to Regal Cinemas nationwide
item.description: The Colombian superstar brings his cinematic alter ego Ferxxo to the big screen for one night only this September.

item.title: Trump seeks Supreme Court approval of USPS mail ballot rule
item.description: A third Supreme Court appeal over mail ballot rules raises durable questions about where federal power ends and state election authority begins.

item.title: Clancy attorney asks Trump for pardon after murder mistrial
item.description: Defense attorney Kevin Reddington appeared on ABC News to request a presidential pardon for his client following a mistrial declared September 4.

item.title: Brazil beat Canada 3-0 to advance to U-20 Women's World Cup last 16
item.description: Brazil crushed Canada 3-0 in Bielsko-Biała to punch their ticket to the U-20 Women's World Cup round of 16.

item.title: Chile central bank holds rate at 4.5% amid inflation and weak growth
item.description: Chile's central bank left its key rate at 4.5% on September 8 as rising inflation and a slumping economy boxed policymakers into inaction.

item.title: Argentina's industry and construction both fall sharply in July
item.description: INDEC data released September 8 show both sectors snapped out of June gains, with machinery and textiles leading the industrial slide.

item.title: Scarlett Camberos becomes first Mexican nominated for Ballon d'Or
item.description: The Club América Femenil striker scored 27 goals in 2025–26 and helped her club win three titles, including Mexican women's football's first continental trophy.

item.title: Clancy attorney asks Trump for pardon after state murder mistrial
item.description: Defense attorney Kevin Reddington made the request on national television four days after a jury deadlocked in the Massachusetts murder case.

item.title: Smithsonian designates Arts and Industries Building as Latino museum home
item.description: After more than three decades of advocacy, the National Museum of the American Latino finally has a permanent address on the National Mall.

item.title: US tightens immigration enforcement with arrests, visa and court changes
item.description: ICE arrests nearly doubled in August 2026 as the administration tightened enforcement through visa suspensions, court rule changes, and accelerated deportations.

item.title: Iceland summons U.S. ambassador over Trump's flag-covered map
item.description: Iceland's foreign minister summoned the U.S. ambassador after President Trump posted a map showing Iceland and other nations covered by the American flag.

item.title: Biden says prostate cancer radiation treatment worked as intended
item.description: The former president said radiation and hormone therapy completed last fall brought his aggressive, bone-metastatic prostate cancer under control.

item.title: Appeals court rules IRS taxpayer data sharing with ICE unlawful
item.description: A federal appeals court unanimously upheld a block on IRS sharing of taxpayer addresses with ICE, ruling the practice violated federal privacy law.

item.title: Messi earns 17th Ballon d'Or nomination while playing for Inter Miami
item.description: France Football's 30-man shortlist puts the 39-year-old one nomination behind Cristiano Ronaldo's all-time record, with a ninth Ballon d'Or win now possible.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to revive SAVE voter-citizenship database
item.description: A decades-old benefits database repurposed for voter rolls reaches the Supreme Court, reopening durable questions about federal power, data reliability, and election administration.

item.title: Julián Quiñones earns 2026 Ballon d'Or nomination for Mexico
item.description: Quiñones lands on France Football's 30-man shortlist after a 33-goal Saudi Pro League season and four World Cup strikes for Mexico.

item.title: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch announces retirement amid Trump pressure
item.description: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch III announced Tuesday he will retire by end of 2026, days after the Trump administration threatened funding cuts.

item.title: Trump awards posthumous Medal of Freedom to 9/11 'red bandana' hero
item.description: President Trump posthumously awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Welles Crowther, the 'man in the red bandana,' at a September 8 commemoration event.

item.title: Chicago Fire host Inter Miami in Messi-Lewandowski MLS showdown
item.description: Inter Miami, first in the East with 43 points, visit Soldier Field on Wednesday to face a Chicago side riding a six-game unbeaten run.

item.title: Scarlett Camberos becomes first Mexican nominated for Ballon d'Or
item.description: The América Femenil forward is one of 30 nominees for the 2026 women's award, and her club is also in contention for Best Women's Club.

item.title: Rubio visits Colombia amid tariff talks and Venezuela oil deal backlash
item.description: Rubio's Bogotá stop on a three-nation Latin America tour puts tariff relief and a Venezuela oil deal under scrutiny.

item.title: Brazil Supreme Court justice removes federal police chief over surveillance claim
item.description: Justice André Mendonça removed the federal police director-general and intelligence chief, citing illegal surveillance of his own activities and contacts.

item.title: Mexico women's U-20 team faces host Poland needing a win
item.description: Mexico needs three points against host Poland on September 8 after throwing away a two-goal lead in a 2-2 draw with Benin.

item.title: Colombia inflation rises to 6.24% as strong peso reshapes economy
item.description: August inflation hit 6.24%, beating forecasts, while the peso's 19–20% gain this year cuts import costs but squeezes exporters and remittance recipients.

item.title: Canada's countertariffs on U.S. goods take effect as Trump threatens Bombardier ban
item.description: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods mark a structural shift in North American trade relations that history suggests won't resolve quickly.
